demo.title: onedollaraudit.ts

setup: No signup, no API key — the x402 payment is the authorization ($1 USDC per audit on Base)
Set `PRIVATE_KEY` to a dedicated wallet holding ~$1 USDC on Base (gasless EIP-3009 — no ETH needed)
POST a description (contract address or pasted Solidity) to `https://leftclaw.services/api/audit` — persist the returned `jobId`
Poll `https://onedollaraudit.com/api/jobs/<jobId>` (free, no auth) until `status: "complete"`, or pass a `callbackUrl` in the POST body to get pushed the result — never re-pay to re-check a job
